speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Stand where they can see your hands, Alse. The meal at the top. The halfpence under.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: It is open, mistress. I can feel the halfpence. I cannot see them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You do not need to see them. Names, not a heap. If I do not know her, she waits until I do.

speaker: (a woman at the step)
text: Goodwife Ansell. It is Margaret, from the alley. Two of mine are at home.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Margaret. A measure of the meal, and four halfpence. You tell me if the loaf is short again.

speaker: (a woman at the step)
text: Short by two fingers and a thumb, mistress. Same penny.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then it is the same penny and a lesser loaf. I will not call it giving if I look away.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The board upstairs wants the same, Mistress. I can put something in the bag.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Not in my bag. It is not charity if you don't know whom you're giving it to.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know Margaret now.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You know her because I said the name. That is this door. Yours is the church box, and I shall be watching.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Four halfpence, and the measure. That is Margaret.

speaker: (a woman at the step)
text: God yield it you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Go home while the meal is dry. Next.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: How many before I put my head out?

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eleven at this door. You may count the church yourself, and you may do it without a speech.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The bag pulls to the one side.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then shift it. A torn sack is a show, and a show is not giving.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will walk over with you.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will walk over after. Your hand stays off this bag. Alse carries it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have it.

speaker: (a second woman)
text: Ann, from the wall. My man is at the river.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Ann. The same measure, and two halfpence. He does not drink this.

speaker: (a second woman)
text: Two, then. God yield it you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Twelve, if Margaret was the eleventh.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twelve. Shut the neck of it. We are not a stall.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twelve at a door is a parish.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Twelve is who came. Mark me. Stay through the next, and then church, and keep your coin in your hand until the box.
